doc: The building animator's input: its moving parts, the local wind (as trees use it), the time, when the door last opened, and the seed.

fields.name: wind_heading
fields.doc: Toward which the wind blows, degrees from +Z toward +X.

fields.name: time
fields.doc: Seconds, for the sway, spin, smoke, and flicker.

fields.name: door_time
fields.doc: Seconds since the door opened; negative while shut. It swings open, stays for a visit, and closes.
